thag7.2:1.1: Pare Ambāṭakārāme vanasaṇḍamhi Bhaddiyo samūlaṃ taṇham abbuyha tattha bhaddo jhiyāyati. || ||
thag7.2:2.1: ramant' eke mutiṅgehi vīṇāhi paṇavehi ca, ahañ ca rukkhamūlasmiṃ rato buddhassa sāsane. || ||
thag7.2:3.1: buddho ca me varaṃ dajjā so ca labbhetha me varo, gaṇhe 'haṃ sabbalokassa niccaṃ kāyagatāsatiṃ. || ||
thag7.2:4.1: ye maṃ rūpena pāmiṃsu ye ca ghosena anvagū chandarāgavasūpetā na maṃ jānanti te janā. || ||
thag7.2:5.1: ajjhattañ ca na jānāti bahiddhā ca na passati samantāvaraṇo bālo, sa ve ghosena vuyhati. || ||
thag7.2:6.1: ajjhattañ ca na jānāti bahiddhā ca vipassati bahiddhāphaladassāvī, so pi ghosena vuyhati. || ||
thag7.2:7.1: ajjhattañ ca pajānāti bahiddhā ca vipassati anāvaraṇadassāvī, na so ghosena vuyhatīti. || || Lakuṇṭako thero.
